textNotes.text: With the launch of the new update today, they have patched some skips in the raid. Thankfully a couple still work including the boss skip, however I've had to find a couple of work arounds. Take a look at the run, and let me know if you've found anything i might have missed.

textNotes.author: @MikeyMadness92
textNotes.text: In kuldra fight, if you look closely when your doing skips you can see little invisible floating cubes and I think those are death cubes you need to avoid, can confirm kuldra skip harder, but doable as before

textNotes.author: @WPWArt
textNotes.text: On the last bit where the elementals are, you can still jump through the gap at the beginning and get off the map. They’ve added some rocks, but if you time it right, you can still do the original skip there to get to kuldras sanctum

textNotes.author: @haydenjones953
textNotes.text:
The vault guardian part- you can jump on the lower part of the pipe and windstep onto the highest part of the pipe (without having to turn the valve to activate the moving platforms)
As for the fire, you can siphon the fire anima without stepping on the centre bit by standing close to it (without having to wake up the vault guardians)

textNotes.author: @iNanobit
textNotes.text: Thanks for the new skip idea after the first BD, I experimented around in that area for awhile, but clearly not enough! I've credited you in the route :)

textNotes.author: @TheBoar6767
textNotes.text: So basically they made this harder and messed up Runecrafting. Welp I'm cheeseing this till Runecrafting is fixed

textNotes.author: @Sir_Rebral
textNotes.text: Fastest is a bit of a lie but that first skip next to the black dragon is new to me. For the Stronghold, you don't need to mine the wall or kill the rats just let the Thane walk out of the room on the right as you enter (he likes to walk through the metal bars) kill him then windstep up. You also don't need to bother activating the ledges in the elemental room either you can just windstep up on to…

textNotes.text: @SectorTSWG  I uploaded a video with the skips I know of personally including the one I just learned from your video so I've credited you in the description

textNotes.text: I just did a run and you can still surge+dash across the broken bridge to get to the final platform

textNotes.author: @SectorTSWG
textNotes.text: ​ @Sir_Rebral last night I did a run, and everything that could go wrong went wrong. Felt like I was being messed with. The skips worked, just wasn't as fluid. Gave up after that.
